decisions.decision: The Board endorsed the ANR plan for 92 Cove Road (property owner conveying .42 acres to the abutter at 82 Cove Road), with no recorded vote.
A. Burney will advertise for the Member-At-Large seat on the Open Space Committee, and the Planning Board can appoint that individual at its July 23 meeting.
decisions.quote: a. burney will advertise for the member-al-large and the planning board can appoint that individual at the july 23d board meeting.

decisions.decision: A. Burney will bring the parking at Asian Imperial Restaurant (driveway removal required by the Board's Decision) to the attention of the Building Commissioner/Zoning Enforcement Officer.
decisions.quote: a. burney will bring this to the attention of the building commissioner/zoning enforcement officer.

budget_items.topic: Host Community Agreement community impact fee and taxes
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Counsel explained that an operator must sign a host community agreement that may include a community impact fee, which must be reasonably related to the town's cost, and that the fee could differ between retail and cultivation facilities; a member asked whether sales, excise and optional local taxes are in addition to the HCA tax.
budget_items.quote: the community impact fee must be reasonably related to the cost imposed on the town by the operation of the specific facility.
